    Section 4.3 for finite-dimensional algebras #

    For a finite-dimensional algebra Λ over a field k, the category mod Λ = FGModuleCat Λᵐᵒᵖ has an indecomposable skeleton (modSkeleton): every module has finite length (isFiniteLength_mod), and the endomorphism ring of every module is a finite-dimensional k-algebra, hence Artinian (isArtinianRing_end_mod). The results of ImageClosure.lean therefore apply to mod Λ; theorem_4_11 records Theorem 4.11 in this setting.
